Sites.Title: Market Research Team
Sites.Description: Navigating Organisational Intelligence — Caldova ALLER launch collaboration site

Messages.Message: Morning all — using this chat as our running war room for the ALLER launch through the executive checkpoint. Ping here for anything time-sensitive.
Sounds good. I'll post supplier updates here as they come in — LumaSterile and HelioPack are the two I'm watching most closely this week.
Heads up @Serena Ribeiro — Signal Ridge confirmed the regulatory authority has formally accepted the revised ALLER dosing claim language. Written confirmation should land by end of day.
That's fantastic news! Huge unblock for the Regulatory Submission Briefing.
Great timing — I was just about to lock the pricing and forecast package for the checkpoint deck.
LumaSterile's re-run sterilization lot for the ALLER-20 auto-injector passed release testing. Combined with the Pioneer validation batch, both manufacturing lines are now fully qualified.
Excellent. That closes out the last major open item on the risk register ahead of the executive checkpoint.
The field team is going to be thrilled to hear supply is secured on both dose strengths. Momentum with accounts has been building since we shared the Q3 forecast.
Pricing and forecast package is finalized and ready for the executive checkpoint deck — parity pricing on ALLER-20 versus the current standard of care, as discussed.
Perfect, I'll pull everything together with the Product Launch Readiness Assessment this week.
One outstanding item: Valence Cold Chain's commercial shipment qualification run completes Thursday. I'll confirm here the moment I have results.
Also worth flagging for the checkpoint, @Serena Ribeiro — three of our top accounts have already asked about the November 3rd availability date. Good sign field readiness is landing well.
@Cassandra Dunn — setting up this chat so we can keep the Product Risk Register in sync with ALLER's regulatory submission status in real time.
Perfect, that'll save us a lot of back-and-forth in email.
The regulatory authority pushed back on our ALLER-20 dosing claim language during the regulatory strategy review this morning. Signal Ridge is drafting revised copy today.
Logging that as a high-priority item on the risk register now, with Signal Ridge as the responsible party and you as internal owner.
Signal Ridge's estimate is two to three weeks for a regulatory response once we resubmit. Will keep you posted here.
Update: the regulatory authority has accepted the revised dosing language. We're finalizing the ALLER package insert now with Signal Ridge.
Great — closing out that risk register item today.

Publishing the first full version of the Product Risk Register today. Regulatory labeling is marked closed; I've opened a new item for the LumaSterile sterilization lot delay on the ALLER-20 auto-injector — flagging that one as owned jointly with Charlotte.
Makes sense, I'll loop Charlotte in on the cost side if the re-run pushes the manufacturing timeline.

Approved ALLER package insert is final and incorporated into all commercial materials. I've drafted the Regulatory Submission Briefing summarizing the full regulatory package — Crescent GMP Labs' stability data is in the appendix.
Noted for the steering committee update. Nice work getting this across the line.
The regulatory authority has formally accepted the dosing claim language in writing — confirmation just came in from Signal Ridge.
Updating the Regulatory Submission Briefing and closing the last open regulatory item on the risk register ahead of the checkpoint.
Starting this thread to keep marketing and sales aligned on ALLER messaging as market access planning evolves.
Appreciate it — the field is eager for updated collateral once dosing language and pricing settle.
Circulated the pricing options doc for your review, @David Power — parity vs. a modest premium for ALLER-20 relative to the current standard of care.
My vote is parity, especially for accounts like Meridian Health Alliance that are price-sensitive on formulary decisions.
Agreed, market research supports that too — @Babak Shammas is finalizing at parity for ALLER-20 with a modest premium reserved for the ALLER-10 starter dose.
Updated launch collateral is in review now that the regulatory-approved dosing language is final. Should be ready by end of week.
Perfect timing — several accounts are asking for updated materials ahead of the November 3rd date.
Forecast numbers are holding steady with the parity pricing assumption baked in — I'll have the final Product Forecasting Report figures in the checkpoint deck.
Great, that lines up with what I'm putting in the Launch Readiness Assessment.
@Serena Ribeiro, appreciate the steady updates. Let me know if anything needs my attention before the checkpoint.
Will do. Right now the two big items are the LumaSterile sterilization re-run for ALLER-20 and finalizing pricing — both tracking to close within a few weeks.
Both of those items are now resolved. We're in strong shape heading into the checkpoint.
Excellent. Please make sure Finance and Compliance have their materials ready as well.
David raised the idea of pulling the launch date forward given the account interest we're seeing — what's your read?
I'd rather hold the current November 3rd date to protect field training and payer outreach timing. Flagged the same to David directly.
Agreed, let's keep the current date. We can revisit if field readiness clearly allows it closer to the checkpoint.
Final readiness materials are ready for next week's executive checkpoint.
Looking forward to it. Great work getting us here.

Sites.Description: Intelligent Investigation - Caldova supplier invoice investigation site

Messages.Message: Morning. Northstar Fill Finish's deviation investigation line is on hold - no approval on record. Heads up if you get questions from their side.
Nothing from me. Sales doesn't touch Northstar invoices.
New one: BluePeak Biologics L004 on INV-SUP-009-2026-Q4-L004 is a contamination investigation charge. Disputed, pay the rest.
@Babak Shammas will you want the line items in the monthly spend summary? I'm pulling it Friday.
Yes, show it as disputed, not approved. I'll update the status once Compliance weighs in.
Status: L004 is escalated. Cassandra has the written position and Charlotte agreed it.
@Babak Shammas thanks for holding L004. Please open the case and loop in Cassandra today.
Done. Case is in the Financial Investigation Case list, status Disputed.
Compliance position is clear: supplier-caused investigations aren't billable. I want the contract amended so we're never back here.
Makes sense. I'll add a mandatory deviation reference per invoice line to the request.
Amendment approved and going to BluePeak Biologics for signature.
@Babak Shammas I've read the deviation record for DEV-BP-1026-SUPPLIER. Root cause points to the supplier.
That matches my read. No change order on file either.
Section 4 of the billability policy covers it. Decision state is escalated.
Position sent to BluePeak Biologics. @Charlotte Waltson I'll update you when they reply.
Thanks. Keep me posted.
